name: Sattar&Co.
heroStatement: A high-calibre legal practice built around expertise, integrity and practical understanding.
introBody: Sattar&Co. advises the business community in Bangladesh and the international counsel and investors who work alongside it. The practice is built on specialist legal skill, a close reading of Bangladesh's regulatory landscape, and the judgment to apply both under pressure.
aboutBody: Sattar&Co. is a corporate, financial and arbitration practice headquartered in Dhaka, advising local and multinational clients across the country's principal industries.

The firm's approach is collaborative rather than transactional: matters are led by senior counsel from first instruction to resolution, with the same discretion a firm of this standing is expected to carry.

That standard has been recognised by the international legal directories for consecutive years, and reflected in mandates spanning banking and finance, energy, aviation, technology, media, telecommunications and cross-border investment.
founded: Head of Firm — Barrister Sameer Sattar
